interface.shortDescription: Play peer-to-peer poker with lifetime Token as per-table chips.
interface.longDescription: Token Poker runs a complete table inside Codex. Its local Rust core handles peer-to-peer matchmaking, private rooms, Mental Poker, co-signed hand receipts, and volunteer Relay. Lifetime Token comes directly from the official Codex App Server account-usage API; it is official server-side usage data, not a balance proof that opponents can verify independently.
